hero.headline: Take the bright way around.
hero.supportingCopy: A neighbourhood coffee bar built for curious palates, slow mornings and plans that run pleasantly late.
hero.announcement: Now pouring our orange hour menu.
hero.imageAlt: Barista finishing a citrus coffee at a warm timber counter

about.heading: Familiar coffee, turned toward the sun.
about.body: Moof is an independent Singapore coffee bar with a soft spot for expressive beans, seasonal ingredients and hospitality that never feels rehearsed.
about.imageAlt: Coffee cherries, roasted beans and a ceramic cup on a walnut table

menuSection.heading: Pick your current mood.
menuSection.intro: Swipe through our house favourites and small seasonal detours.

story.heading: We follow flavour, not a formula.
story.body: Our menu changes when the produce, weather or collective mood tells us it should. Behind every cup is patient sourcing, precise brewing and enough room for an unexpected idea.
story.note: Roasted with care. Served without ceremony.

events.heading: Make the room yours.
events.body: From thoughtful team mornings to intimate wedding evenings, we shape the food, coffee and room around your kind of gathering.
events.imageAlt: Warm cafe event table set with flowers, candles and ceramic coffee cups

visit.heading: Come by, stay awhile.
visit.body: Walk in for coffee, lunch, or the seat by the window.

business.heading: Coffee can start a good conversation.
business.body: Wholesale, collaborations, pop-ups and partnerships—we would like to hear what you are building.
